operations.summary: Open a tenant as a reseller, suspend or resume it, set its parameters
operations.description: revision 0 opens the tenant as a reseller (status must be active); otherwise revision is the current one. An active reseller's tenant_owner role holds reseller.packages.manage, reseller.customers.manage and reseller.customers.read; suspending takes them away (customers and sold subscriptions stay). A tenant under a reseller cannot become one (422 reseller_one_level). Prepaid wholesale: each order of the reseller's package charges its wholesale cost W (by wholesale_price_list) from the prepaid balance; when an order takes the balance below low_balance_minor the reseller is notified (reseller.prepaid.low_balance).
